producer.note: Construction belongs to the retained producer; its mesh-export event succeeded, but the producer run did not complete and provides no engineering acceptance.

source_mesh.derivation: Native export of the imported retained STL before repair; derived geometry, not a claim of byte identity with the imported file.

slice.exit_code_limit: Provider-contract evidence based on offline CLI return code, not an independently observed exit code.

design_values.envelope_limit_mm: 38.0 diameter x 18.0 high including 2 mm hub
design_values.grip: six equally spaced R8 scallops at 24.75 mm center radius; nominal minimum grip diameter 33.5 mm; nominal R1 exposed-edge rounds; twelve 1.2 mm diameter x 0.35 mm spherical grip caps at radius 13.5 mm
design_values.hub: 12 mm diameter, visible z=16..18 mm, with 0.2 mm hidden union overlap
design_values.socket_interpretation: Concentric blind D socket, 10.0 mm deep, constructed as R3.20 circle clipped at x=-2.40 mm. This represents 0.20 mm radial clearance from a 6.00 mm round boundary and 0.20 mm flat clearance from a 5.20 mm across-flat shaft. No set screw, insert, taper or keyway. Nominal roof is 6.0 mm, exceeding the 3.0 mm minimum.
design_values.non_mating_tolerance_mm: proposed ±0.25; not applicable as a future measured-fit result

measured_mesh.note: Mesh measurements are separate from nominal design values and do not establish physical fit.

preparation_observations.orientation: Repaired geometry was rotated 180 degrees about X and translated to minimum Z=0, making the blind D-socket opening face +Z. This protects the opening from direct build-plate contact but puts the raised front hub at the build-plate side.
preparation_observations.support_consequence: The 2 mm hub can elevate surrounding front-face regions and create broad underside overhangs. Actual nominal toolpaths contain support, so zero support is not claimed.

profile_evidence.qualification: Inspected slice evidence records these profile artifacts and package binding but does not expose their setting contents; exact required values above therefore remain requirements rather than independently verified profile observations. PLA cannot satisfy the requirement.

nominal_toolpaths.qualification: Nominal sliced paths only; startup/shutdown sections were excluded, firmware was not executed, and no print occurred.
